messages.text:
I've sent this to our technical specialist, who will answer you here in this chat. I didn't write a reply myself, because a faulty unit goes to tech support before anything else.

He has the whole history: your Thor P2 on order Shop···· shows a red "power board error" on first boot, then an "over temp" restart loop within 10 to 20 seconds. The fans run fast, you're on the stock power supply and the room is 72°F. He'll pick up where the last chat stopped, which was getting the temperature readings.
